correctness.rationale: Exact block multiplication gives the quadratic/cubic identities. The three parity cases exhaust all integral k,c; matrix entry valuations at exponents 1,2,3,4 are proved exactly from congruences, not inferred from searches or finite samples. For depth beyond valuation two, (I+2^rE)^2-I has exact valuation r+1. The modulo-two order and 2-group reduction kernels force minimality at every depth. Direct two-by-two scalar mode valuations independently show the index factor; change of modes has determinant -2. The package checker completed 16962 exact integer congruence assertions, including all mod-eight seed residue classes. See RESULT.md Sections Proof and Verification; no infinite assertion depends only on finite tests.

value.rationale: The underlying 2022 authors specifically treat even finite-torus moduli as delicate. A complete all-depth two-weight period phase diagram is a natural mathematical invariant of the model; its exact two-adic valuation boundary predicts finite-state recurrence over every grid resolution. The mode-index defect is structural: rational Fourier decomposition has determinant two, and the theorem proves precisely when that defect doubles the actual permutation order. This is not merely another unweighted matrix entry or an arbitrary small computation; it resolves a natural symmetry-versus-integrality question, though it does not classify individual orbit multiplicities.
